title: Garrett Graff's UFO debunking book after the Aspen Institute pre-bunking

tellings.quote: Garett graph comes out with a book on UFOs earlier this year called UFO and it's basically just a debunking of all these cases

plain: A journalist named Garrett Graff put out a book simply called UFO, which the journalist Michael Shellenberger says came out earlier in 2024 and is "basically just a debunking" of the famous sightings. Shellenberger links the book to the Aspen Institute, a US policy organisation, and to a media executive named Vivian Schiller. He suggests the book followed an effort there to "pre-bunk" UFO stories, meaning to get the public to doubt them before they came out. If he is right, the debunking was planned ahead of time rather than reached independently.
